metadata.proof: SOURCE: All routes in app.py return HTML responses via render_template() or raw string concatenation -> SINK: No @app.after_request hook sets X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. If an attacker can inject content into any response (already possible via XSS at lines 120, 183, or SSTI at line 205), and the response is served without a proper Content-Type or with a generic type like text/html, the browser may interpret non-HTML content as executable script, amplifying XSS attacks.
